import Base

# Each field is a bit-plane: thirty-two cells count without carrying into each other.
type Counts is Data:
  Counts{one: U32, two: U32, four: U32, eight: U32}

# Add one simultaneous vote to every set bit.
def Counts.vote(counts: Counts, +votes: U32) -> Counts:
  match counts:
    case Counts{+one, +two, +four, eight}:
      +into_two = U32.and(one, votes)
      +into_four = U32.and(two, into_two)
      into_eight = U32.and(four, into_four)
      Counts{
        U32.xor(one, votes),
        U32.xor(two, into_two),
        U32.xor(four, into_four),
        U32.xor(eight, into_eight)
      }

# A source row casts left, middle and right; middle=0 removes the focal cells.
def Counts.cast(counts: Counts, +row: U32, middle: U32) -> Counts:
  Counts.vote(
    Counts.vote(
      Counts.vote(counts, U32.shl(row)),
      middle),
    U32.shr(row))

# Binary 2-or-3 becomes: two, no four/eight, and either one or already alive.
def Life.rule(counts: Counts, alive: U32) -> U32:
  match counts:
    case Counts{one, two, four, eight}:
      U32.and(
        two,
        U32.and(
          U32.not(four),
          U32.and(U32.not(eight), U32.or(one, alive))))

# Three casts are the Moore stencil: 3 above, 2 here, 3 below.
def Life.row(+above: U32, +here: U32, +below: U32) -> U32:
  Life.rule(
    Counts.cast(
      Counts.cast(
        Counts.cast(Counts{0, 0, 0, 0}, above, above),
        here,
        0),
      below,
      below),
    here)

# Row-major cells enter a row least-significant bit first.
def Rows.pack.one(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, +shift: Nat, row: U32
) -> U32:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      row
    case cell <> rest:
      Rows.pack.one(
        rest,
        1n+shift,
        U32.or(row, U32.shln(cell, shift)))

def Rows.pack(
  height: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      Rows.pack.one(List.take(&2, U32, cells, width), 0n, 0)
        <> Rows.pack(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

# The zero rows implicit at both ends are the vertical dead boundary.
def Life.sweep(rows: List<&2, U32>, above: U32) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case +here <> +below:
      match below:
        case Nil{}:
          Life.row(above, here, 0) <> Nil{}
        case next <> _:
          Life.row(above, here, next)
            <> Life.sweep(below, here)

# Packing and unpacking use the same least-significant-bit-first basis.
def Rows.unpack.one(width: Nat, +row: U32) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match width:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      U32.and(row, 1) <> Rows.unpack.one(rest, U32.shr(row))

def Rows.unpack(
  rows: List<&2, U32>, +width: Nat
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case row <> rest:
      List.append(
        &2,
        U32,
        Rows.unpack.one(width, row),
        Rows.unpack(rest, width))

def step(
  width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +columns = U32.to_nat(width)
  Rows.unpack(
    Life.sweep(
      Rows.pack(U32.to_nat(height), columns, cells),
      0),
    columns)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
